harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Configured node1 as the DNSSEC-signing primary for infra.test, node2 and node3 as authenticated-transfer secondaries, and node4 to persistently use both secondaries. Signed records resolve correctly, authenticated updates propagate, unkeyed updates are refused, and resolution survived a secondary outage. All four nodes were rebooted sequentially and fully recovered with changed boot identities.
actions_performed: Installed and configured BIND with automatic inline DNSSEC signing.
Published app.infra.test A 10.100.102.10 and status.infra.test TXT ready.
Generated protected TSIG update and transfer credentials on node1.
Enabled authenticated notify and zone transfers to node2 and node3.
Persisted node2 and node3 as node4's DNS servers through NetworkManager.
Verified authenticated updates and removed the temporary verification record afterward.
Stopped node2, demonstrated automatic resolution through node3, then restored node2.
Rebooted node1, node2, node3, and node4 one at a time and verified recovery after each.

evidence.requirement: Authoritative DNSSEC topology and required records
evidence.summary: Current direct checks identify node1 as the secure inline-signing primary and node2/node3 as secure secondaries at signed serial 2026090206; all serve app, status, DNSKEY, and RRSIG data.
NetworkManager persistently lists both secondary addresses; after reboot, node4 resolves signed records normally and direct queries to both secondaries succeed.

evidence.requirement: Authenticated updates from node1 propagate to both secondaries
evidence.summary: A keyed update was accepted and propagated with matching signatures; an unkeyed update returned REFUSED. A post-restart authenticated cleanup advanced the signed serial to 2026090206 on both secondaries.

evidence.requirement: Resolution remains available if one authoritative server is unavailable
evidence.summary: After a healthy two-secondary baseline, node2 was stopped with no DNS listener. node4 automatically answered through node3, including current signed data, and node2 subsequently recovered at the current serial.
Healthy baseline, acknowledged reboot, changed boot ID, and recovered active secure primary with persistent signed data.
Healthy baseline, acknowledged reboot, changed boot ID, and recovered active secure secondary with current signed data.
Healthy baseline, acknowledged reboot, changed boot ID, and recovered active secure secondary with current signed data.
Healthy resolver baseline, acknowledged reboot, changed boot ID, and recovered persistent two-secondary configuration and signed resolution.
